name: Cania
title: Cania: The Eighth Layer
description: Cania is the eighth layer of the Nine Hells, an unimaginably cold wasteland with huge glaciers racing across the landscape.
wiki: Cania is the domain of Mephistopheles, who rules from the citadel of Mephistar. It is a realm of absolute zero, where the very air can freeze a creature solid in seconds.
